notes.title: Update #2
notes.content: In this update, one giant game breaking glitch has been fixed. When players minimized the window, and then returned to it, the whole level would light up. This simple update fixed the issue, though a quick flicker still occurs.

notes.title: NodziGames made the first Flappy Bird game?
notes.content:
So I was searching the internet today, trying to track some of the first games I ever made, and I ran back into this: 

http://sandbox.yoyogames.com/games/199667-paper-planes-2

I made the game in 2012, and the date is visible on the website to those who don't believe me. I realized how much potential the game had, but it's a bit too late to cry about it. I highly regret not taking game development more seriously back then xD.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content: Sometimes received a very minor update. This update added a facebook button which will direct you to our official FB Page! This update also introduces a 0.25 second delay when you die, so no more running into those darn blades!
